column8: comment

DIVERGES FROM STOCK - decide before replacing clinvar.  This previously claimed basis java:ClinvarConverter, which is false: the converter sets primaryIdentifier from `line[0]` of variant_summary.txt, the numeric AlleleID (e.g. 205807), never the VCV accession.  VCV is what rdf-config's own model uses to identify a record and is a sound identifier, so it stays mapped - but loading it in place of stock clinvar changes every Allele.primaryIdentifier, which breaks saved lists, templates and anything keyed on AlleleID. To match stock instead, key on cvo:allele_id (column allele_id) - that id sits on the SIO_000628 node, not the record root, so it is a structural change, not a one-line swap.
